title: Apigenin regulates CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs signaling to alleviate secondary brain injury after intracerebral hemorrhage and its enhanced delivery via targeted nanoparticles.
authors: Wu, Jia-Wei; Zhou, Yi-Ting; Wang, Bing-Xin; Shen, Li-Ping; Zhang, Xu-Qi; Du, Zhi-Yong; Wang, Peng; Lu, Xiao-Jie; Miao, Zeng-Li; Zhao, Xu-Dong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芹菜素通过纳米颗粒递送调控CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs信号通路治疗脑出血后继发性脑损伤，核心为小分子-蛋白信号通路与药物递送，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), a severe cerebrovascular disorder with high mortality, leads to secondary brain injury (SBI) primarily through neuroinflammation and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption. Among the pathological cascades, excessive activation of macrophages and the CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs signaling pathway play pivotal roles in amplifying neuronal damage. Apigenin (API), a natural flavonoid with anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, has emerged as a promising therapeutic candidate to counteract these processes. In this study, we developed apigenin-loaded PLGA nanoparticles functionalized with DSPE-PEG2000-RVG29 and DSPE-PEG2000-folic acid (RVG/FA-NPs@API) to achieve targeted delivery to inflammatory macrophages and investigated their therapeutic effects against SBI after ICH. In a murine ICH model, API administration significantly improved neurological outcomes, reduced cerebral edema, suppressed neuronal apoptosis, and preserved BBB integrity. Mechanistically, API bound covalently to JAK1 at Cys1052, inhibiting its phosphorylation and subsequently downregulating the CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs cascade. Furthermore, RVG/FA-NPs@API demonstrated excellent stability, efficient brain-targeting, and superior biocompatibility, achieving enhanced therapeutic efficacy compared with free API. These findings highlight a novel strategy for targeted immunomodulation and provide translational insights into nanoparticle-assisted delivery of natural compounds for the treatment of ICH-induced SBI.
abstract_zh: 脑出血（ICH）是一种死亡率高的严重脑血管疾病，主要通过神经炎症和血脑屏障（BBB）破坏导致继发性脑损伤（SBI）。在病理级联反应中，巨噬细胞的过度激活及CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs信号通路在放大神经元损伤中发挥关键作用。芹菜素（API）是一种具有抗炎和神经保护特性的天然黄酮类化合物，已成为对抗这些过程的有前景的治疗候选药物。在本研究中，我们开发了负载芹菜素的PLGA纳米颗粒，并用DSPE-PEG2000-RVG29和DSPE-PEG2000-叶酸进行功能化修饰（RVG/FA-NPs@API），以实现对炎症巨噬细胞的靶向递送，并研究了其对ICH后SBI的治疗效果。在小鼠ICH模型中，API给药显著改善了神经功能结局，减轻了脑水肿，抑制了神经元凋亡，并保持了BBB完整性。机制上，API通过共价结合JAK1的Cys1052位点，抑制其磷酸化，进而下调CCR5/JAK1/STAT1/MMPs级联反应。此外，RVG/FA-NPs@API表现出优异的稳定性、高效的脑靶向性和良好的生物相容性，与游离API相比实现了更强的治疗效果。这些发现突显了一种靶向免疫调节的新策略，并为纳米颗粒辅助递送天然化合物治疗ICH诱导的SBI提供了转化性见解。
